summary: Alder Studio: a team work tracker where authenticated members create projects, add and progress tasks, filter a board and a list, read a computed analytics summary, and administrators manage member roles

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: signed-out visitors are redirected to /login when opening any dashboard route
authenticated members can read shared Alder Studio projects, tasks and member display information
authenticated members can create projects and tasks and update task status
only administrators can open /admin and update member roles
non-administrator members see Access denied on /admin and cannot see role editing controls

routes.name: Projects
routes.purpose: the project list and the new project form

routes.name: Project
routes.purpose: one project, its tasks and the add task form

routes.name: Task Board
routes.purpose: tasks grouped by status with filters

routes.name: Task List
routes.purpose: every task as a searchable, filterable list

routes.name: Analytics
routes.purpose: the computed summary of projects and tasks

entities.name: project
relationships: a project is owned by one member

entities.name: task
relationships: a task belongs to one project
a task is owned by one member

entities.name: member
relationships: a member maps to one authenticated platform user

entities.name: analyticsSummary
entities.storage: computed on read from saved projects and tasks

operations.description: authenticate an existing member with email and password via the backend SDK
persist a new project via the entity store
persist a new task for a project via the entity store
persist a changed task status via the entity store
match saved tasks by search text, selected status and selected owner; all-statuses and all-owners are all-options sentinels

responsibilities.behavior: match saved tasks by search text, selected status and selected owner; all-statuses and all-owners are all-options sentinels

operations.description: compute totals, completion rate and a status breakdown from the saved projects and tasks

responsibilities.behavior: count projects and tasks, count completed and blocked tasks, derive the completion rate and a per-status breakdown

operations.description: persist a changed member role via the entity store (administrators only)

journeys.title: A member signs in with email and password

steps.action: open the sign-in page
steps.expect: the Alder Studio sign-in form with email and password fields is visible

steps.action: enter the email and password and sign in
steps.expect: the Alder Studio Projects heading is visible

acceptance: a member who signs in lands on the projects page

journeys.title: A member creates a project and opens it

steps.action: open the projects page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the Alder Studio Projects heading, the New Project form and the project list are visible

steps.action: create a new project with a title, client, active status and owner
steps.expect: the created project appears in the project list with its title, client and Active status

steps.action: open the created project detail page
steps.expect: the project detail page shows the project title, the task section and the Add Task form

acceptance: a created project survives a reload and can be opened from the list

journeys.title: A member opens the created project by its returned identity

steps.action: open the projects page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the project list shows the created project card

steps.action: open the created project detail page
steps.expect: the project detail page shows the project title and the task section

journeys.title: A member adds a task to the created project

steps.action: open the projects page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the project list shows the created project card

steps.action: open the created project detail page
steps.expect: the project detail page shows the Add Task form

steps.action: add a task with a title, To Do status, owner and due date
steps.expect: the new task is visible in the project task list with its title, owner and a To Do status badge

journeys.title: A member moves the created task to In Progress

steps.action: open the projects page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the project list shows the created project card

steps.action: open the created project detail page
steps.expect: the project detail page shows the task list with the created task

steps.action: change the task status to In Progress
steps.expect: the task row shows an In Progress status badge

journeys.title: The task status survives a reload

steps.action: open the projects page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the project list shows the created project card

steps.action: open the created project detail page
steps.expect: the project detail page shows the task list with the created task

steps.action: reload the project detail page
steps.expect: the same project and task are still visible and the task still shows In Progress

journeys.title: A member filters the board by status and owner

steps.action: open the board page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the Task Board shows columns for To Do, In Progress, Review, Blocked and Done

steps.action: filter the board by a status and an owner
steps.expect: only task cards with To Do status owned by Ada Morgan are visible and the filter summary names To Do and Ada Morgan

journeys.title: A member searches the task list and clears every filter

steps.action: open the task list page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the Task List shows task rows and the search and filter controls

steps.action: search the list for a task title while leaving status at the all-statuses sentinel
steps.expect: the task list shows at least one row containing Kickoff and no row that omits Kickoff

steps.action: clear all filters
steps.expect: the filter summary disappears and the full task list is visible again

journeys.title: The analytics summary is computed on arrival

steps.action: open the analytics page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the Analytics Summary heading and metric cards for total projects, total tasks, completed tasks, blocked tasks and completion rate are visible

steps.action: refresh the summary
steps.expect: the metric cards show numbers computed from the saved projects and tasks

steps.action: open the status breakdown section
steps.expect: a status breakdown lists counts for To Do, In Progress, Review, Blocked and Done

journeys.title: An administrator changes a member's role

steps.action: open the sign-in page
steps.expect: the Alder Studio sign-in form is visible

steps.action: sign in as the seeded administrator
steps.expect: the Alder Studio Projects heading is visible

steps.action: open the team administration page
steps.expect: the Team Administration heading, the members table and the role controls are visible

steps.action: select a member row to edit
steps.expect: the selected member row is highlighted and its current role is displayed

steps.action: change the selected member's role to administrator
steps.expect: the selected row shows an administrator role badge and a Role saved confirmation

steps.action: reload the team administration page
steps.expect: the same member still shows the administrator role badge after reload

journeys.title: A member without the administrator role is denied administration

steps.action: open the team administration page as an authenticated member without the administrator role
steps.expect: an Access denied message is visible and no role editing controls are visible

steps.action: open the projects page as the same member
steps.expect: the Alder Studio Projects heading is visible and the member can see the project list

states.validation: a project needs a title and a client

acceptance.statement: a project created in the browser is listed after a full page reload
a task status changed in the browser is still shown after a full page reload
the board and the list show only tasks matching the applied filters until the filters are cleared
a member without the administrator role sees Access denied on the administration page

deferred.item: email notifications when a task changes owner
deferred.reason: not part of the first tracker release
